The '''Bright Tree Village Observatory''' was the observatory located within the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==History==
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] and his friends liked to visit the observatory on occasion.
